addon.name: The First Dream
addon.description: An expansion of new classes and subclasses for the Lastdream setting. Requires Lastdream Core. Adds four playable classes Warlock, Assassin, Witch, and Brawler — each with two subclasses and full ability presets.
addon.author: atelier.dev

hope_ability.title: Patron's Boon
hope_ability.description: Spend 3 Hope to call out to your patron for help, gaining 1d4 Favor.

class_abilities.title: Warlock Patron
class_abilities.description: You have committed yourself to a patron (god, demon, fae, or other supernatural entity) in exchange for power. Write their name on your sheet. Then choose their spheres of influence, at GM discretion (Nature & Mischief, Love & War, Knowledge & Shadow, etc.), record them, and set their values to +2. Every tier, these spheres of influence gain a permanent +1 bonus. Before making an action roll that relates to one of your patron's spheres of influence, you can spend a Favor to call on them and add its value to the roll.

class_abilities.title: Favor
class_abilities.description: Start with 3 Favor. During a rest, spend one of your downtime moves to tithe to your patron. When you do, gain Favor equal to your Presence. If you choose to forgo this offering, the GM instead gains a Fear.

class_abilities.title: Marked for Death
class_abilities.description: On a successful weapon attack, you can mark a Stress to make the target Marked for Death. Attacks you make against a target that's Marked for Death gain a bonus to damage equal to +1d4 per tier. You can only have one adversary Marked for Death at a time, and can't transfer or remove the condition except by defeating the target. The GM can spend a number of Fear equal to your Proficiency to remove the Marked for Death condition. Otherwise, it ends automatically when you take a rest.

class_abilities.title: Get In & Get Out
class_abilities.description: Spend a Hope to ask the GM for either a quick or inconspicuous way into or out of a building or structure you can see. The next roll you make that capitalizes on this information has advantage.

hope_ability.title: Witch's Charm
hope_ability.description: When you or an ally within Far range rolls a failure on an action roll, you can spend 3 Hope to change it into a success with Fear instead.

class_abilities.title: Hex
class_abilities.description: When a creature causes you or an ally within Close range to mark any Hit Points, you can mark a Stress to Hex them. Action and damage rolls against a Hexed creature gain a bonus equal to your tier. This condition lasts until the GM spends a number of Fear equal to your Spellcast trait to remove it or you Hex another creature. Otherwise, remove it when the scene ends.

class_abilities.title: Commune
class_abilities.description: Once per long rest, during a moment of calm, you can commune with an ancestor, deity, nature spirit, or otherworldly being. Ask them a question, then roll a number of d6s equal to your Spellcast trait. Choose one value from the rolled results and reference the chart below for the effect. 1-3: You taste a flavor, smell a scent, or feel a sensation relevant to the answer. 4-5: You hear sounds or see a vision relevant to the answer. 6: You psychically experience a scene relevant to the answer as if you were there.

hope_ability.title: Staggering Strike
hope_ability.description: Spend 3 Hope when you succeed on an attack to temporarily Stagger your target and force them to mark a Stress. While Staggered, they have disadvantage on attack rolls.

class_abilities.title: I Am the Weapon
class_abilities.description: While you don't have any equipped weapons: you gain a +1 bonus to Evasion; your unarmed strikes are considered a Melee weapon, use the trait of your choice, and deal d8+d6 phy damage using your Proficiency.

class_abilities.title: Combo Strikes
class_abilities.description: After making a damage roll with a Melee weapon but before dealing that damage to the target, mark a Stress to start a combo strike. When you do, roll your Combo Die (starts as a d4) and note its value, then roll it again. If the second roll is equal to or greater than the first, keep rolling until a roll comes in lower than the one before it. Total all rolled values and add that amount to your weapon's damage; these values cannot be adjusted by features that affect damage dice. Once per tier, you may use an advancement option to increase your Combo Die instead of its normal benefit.

class_abilities.title: Patron's Mantle
class_abilities.description: Mark a Stress to cloak yourself in a terrifying aspect of your Patron that lasts until you take Severe damage or the scene ends. When you would mark an Armor Slot, you can spend 2 Favor instead. You gain a bonus equal to your tier on action rolls to intimidate a target.

class_abilities.title: Deadly Devotion
class_abilities.description: On a successful attack, you can spend a Favor to gain a +1 bonus to your Evasion until you mark a Hit Point or take a rest.

class_abilities.title: Draining Invocation
class_abilities.description: When an adversary attacks you or an ally within Very Close range, you can spend a Favor to make them use a d12 instead of a d20 for the attack roll. Additionally, the adversary must mark a Stress, and you can clear a Stress.

class_abilities.title: Dark Aegis
class_abilities.description: Once per long rest, when you would mark any number of Hit Points, you can spend a Favor instead.

class_abilities.title: Draining Bane
class_abilities.description: When an adversary attacks you or an ally within Very Close range, you can spend 2 Favor to temporarily Drain them. When you do, they must mark a Stress and you can clear a Stress. A Drained creature uses a d12 instead of a d20 for attack rolls.

class_abilities.title: Favored Weapon
class_abilities.description: Mark a Stress to Imbue your weapon with your Patron's fury until you deal Severe damage. On a successful Imbued weapon attack, you can spend any number of Favor to gain a +1d6 damage bonus for each Favor spent.

class_abilities.title: Herald of Death
class_abilities.description: When you fail an attack roll, you can spend a Favor to reroll it. If it fails again, mark a Stress and take the new result.

class_abilities.title: Menacing Reach
class_abilities.description: When you Imbue your weapon with your Patron's fury, you can mark an additional Stress to increase its range by one step (Melee to Very Close, Very Close to Close, etc.).

class_abilities.title: Diminish My Foes
class_abilities.description: When you succeed with Hope on an action roll against a target, you can spend a Hope to make your target mark a Stress.

class_abilities.title: Fearsome Attack
class_abilities.description: You can always spend a Favor to reroll any number of your damage dice. You can continue spending Favor to reroll as many times as you'd like.

class_abilities.title: Divine Ire
class_abilities.description: Once per rest, when you take damage, you can spend any number of Favor to target that many adversaries within Close range. Each target must mark a Hit Point.

class_abilities.title: First Strike
class_abilities.description: The first time in a scene you succeed on an attack roll, double the damage of the attack.

class_abilities.title: Ambush
class_abilities.description: Your Marked for Death feature uses d6s instead of d4s.

class_abilities.title: Death Strike
class_abilities.description: When you deal Severe damage to a creature, you can mark a Stress to make them mark an additional Hit Point.

class_abilities.title: Scorpion's Poise
class_abilities.description: You gain a +2 bonus to your Evasion against any attacks made by a creature Marked for Death.

class_abilities.title: True Strike
class_abilities.description: Once per long rest, when you fail an attack roll, you can spend a Hope to make it a success instead.

class_abilities.title: Backstab
class_abilities.description: Your Marked for Death feature uses d8s instead of d6s.

class_abilities.title: Toxic Concoctions
class_abilities.description: Mark a Stress to add 1d4+1 tokens to this card. On your next long rest, clear this card. You know these poisons: Gorgon Root — the target gains a permanent -1 penalty to their Difficulty (once only). Grave Spore — the target must also mark a Stress. Leech Weed — gain a +1d6 damage bonus on this attack.

class_abilities.title: Envenomate
class_abilities.description: When you make a successful weapon attack, you can spend a token from your Toxic Concoctions to afflict the target with a known poison's effect.

class_abilities.title: Poison Compendium
class_abilities.description: You also know these poisons: Midnight's Veil — the target gains a permanent -2 penalty to attack rolls (once only). Ghost Petal — permanently decrease the damage dice of the target's standard attack by one step, e.g. d10 to d8 (once only).

class_abilities.title: Adder's Blessing
class_abilities.description: You are immune to poisons and other toxins.

class_abilities.title: Venomancer
class_abilities.description: You also know these poisons: Blight Seed — the target gains a permanent -3 penalty to their Difficulty (once only). Fear Leaf — this attack gains a damage bonus equal to the result of your Fear Die.

class_abilities.title: Twin Fang
class_abilities.description: When you afflict a target with a known poison's effect, you can spend an additional token to inflict the effect of a second known poison.

class_abilities.title: Herbal Remedies
class_abilities.description: When you or an ally clear one or more Hit Points or Stress as the result of using a consumable, increase the number cleared by one.

class_abilities.title: Tethered Talisman
class_abilities.description: Once per rest, mark a Stress to imbue a small item with your protective essence. When the person holding the talisman takes damage, you can expend its magic to reduce the number of Hit Points they mark by one. You can't create a new talisman until the old one has been used.

class_abilities.title: Walk Between Worlds
class_abilities.description: Make a Spellcast Roll (13) to step beyond the veil of death and converse with any nearby spirits. Place a number of tokens equal to your Spellcast trait on this card and remove one each time a spirit answers a question. You return to the mortal realm when the last token is removed.

class_abilities.title: Enhanced Hex
class_abilities.description: Attacks you make against Hexed creatures gain a damage bonus equal to your Proficiency.

class_abilities.title: Circle of Power
class_abilities.description: Once per rest, mark a circle on the ground around you up to Very Close range and place a number of tokens equal to your Spellcast trait on this card. Each time you or an ally within the circle makes an action roll or is hit with an attack, remove a token. This spell lasts until the last token is removed or you step out of the circle. While within the circle, you and your allies gain a +4 bonus to damage thresholds, a +2 bonus to attack rolls, and a +1 bonus to Evasion.

class_abilities.title: Night's Glamour
class_abilities.description: Mark a Stress to Glamour yourself in a magical facade that lasts until you mark a Hit Point, make an attack, or take a rest. While Glamoured, you can disguise yourself to look like any creature of your approximate size that you've seen, and enhance your own appearance, gaining advantage on Presence Rolls that leverage this change.

class_abilities.title: Moonbeam
class_abilities.description: Once per session, you can conjure a column of moonlight that illuminates the area within Close range until the end of the scene. While bathed in this moonlight, you and any allies gain a +1 bonus to Spellcast Rolls and advantage on rolls to see through illusions.

class_abilities.title: Ire of Pale Light
class_abilities.description: When a Hexed creature within Far range fails an attack roll, they must mark a Stress.

class_abilities.title: Lunar Phases
class_abilities.description: Your spirit ebbs and flows like the phases of the moon. At the beginning of each session, roll a d4 and gain the matching effect until the end of the session. 1 New: you can always spend a Hope to reduce Minor damage to None. 2 Waxing: gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls. 3 Full: gain a +2 bonus to damage thresholds. 4 Waning: gain a +1 bonus to Evasion.

class_abilities.title: Powerhouse
class_abilities.description: Increase the d8 damage dice for your unarmed attack to d10s. Additionally, you can mark a Stress to target two creatures within Melee range with a single attack roll.

class_abilities.title: Overwhelm
class_abilities.description: On a successful attack, you can spend a Hope to force the target to mark a Stress or to throw them within Close range.

class_abilities.title: Rugged
class_abilities.description: Gain a permanent +3 bonus to your Severe damage threshold. Additionally, your Powerhouse feature can target up to three creatures instead of two.

class_abilities.title: Eye for an Eye
class_abilities.description: When you mark more than one Hit Point from an attack in Melee range, the attacker must make a Reaction Roll (13). On a failure, once per long rest, they immediately mark the same number of Hit Points in return.

class_abilities.title: Pummeljoy
class_abilities.description: When you critically succeed on a weapon attack in Melee range, you gain an additional Hope, clear an additional Stress, and gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency for the attack.

class_abilities.title: Not Done Yet
class_abilities.description: When you mark more than one Hit Point from an attack, you can gain a Hope or clear a Stress.

class_abilities.title: Martial Form
class_abilities.description: Take the Martial Form sheet. You start with two martial stances from Tier 1; when you reach a new tier, take two additional stances at your tier or lower. Spend a Focus to activate or shift into a stance; it lasts until you mark your last Hit Point, take Severe damage, the scene ends, or you shift into another stance. Tier 1: Brutal — when you roll the maximum value on a damage die, roll an additional damage die. Defensive — attack rolls against you have disadvantage unless the adversary marks a Stress. Grappling — on a successful attack, spend a Focus to make the target temporarily Restrained. Steady — gain a -1 penalty to Evasion; when you deal damage, roll an additional damage die and drop the lowest. Precise — gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls. Quick — when making an attack roll, spend a Focus to include an additional target within range. Tier 2: Deadly — when you deal Severe damage, the target marks an additional Hit Point. Hindering — on a successful attack, spend a Focus to make the target temporarily Hindered (-2 to attack rolls). Invigorating — when you make a successful attack, roll a d4; on a 4, gain a Focus. Immovable — gain a +2 bonus to damage thresholds and cannot be moved unwillingly. Nimble — when an adversary makes a successful attack against you, spend a number of Focus to roll that many d6s; if any match, you take damage from the attack. Otherworldly — you can choose to deal Physical or Magic damage. Scary — successful attacks also force the target to mark a Stress. Tier 3: Deflecting — when targeted by an attack, spend 2 Focus to gain a bonus to Evasion equal to your Armor Score against that attack. Devastating — spend a Focus before your attack roll to use d20s as your damage dice instead. Dueling — gain advantage on attack rolls when there are no other adversaries or allies in Very Close range of you or your target. Compounding — when you roll the maximum value on a Combo Die, increase the size of the subsequent Combo Dice you roll for the attack (max d12s). Inexorable — attacks against you have disadvantage if you have more than two adversaries within Melee of you. Favored — add the trait of your choice to your damage roll. Sheltering — when you mark an Armor Slot, it reduces damage for you and all allies within Very Close range who took the same damage. Tier 4: Crushing — when you roll a 1 on a damage die, it can be treated as the highest value on the die instead. Infuriating — on a successful attack, the target becomes Furious; while Furious, they are Vulnerable and have a -2 penalty to attack rolls, and can only clear Furious by succeeding on an attack against you. Sweeping — your attack targets all adversaries within Very Close range; deal half damage to all targets you succeed against. Discerning — you may choose the target of your attack after making your attack roll; the GM will tell you where the attack would succeed.

class_abilities.title: Focus
class_abilities.description: During a rest, roll a number of d6s equal to your Instinct and place Focus tokens equal to the highest value rolled.

class_abilities.title: Keen Defenses
class_abilities.description: When you are targeted by an attack, you can spend a Focus to give the attack roll disadvantage.

class_abilities.title: Spirit Blast
class_abilities.description: Spend a Focus to make an Instinct Roll against an adversary within Close range. On a success, deal d20+3 magic damage using your Proficiency, and you can spend an additional Focus to make them temporarily Vulnerable.

class_abilities.title: Limit Breaker
class_abilities.description: Once per rest, you can perform an unbelievable feat such as running across water, leaping between distant rooftops, or scaling the side of a building without needing to roll. When you do, gain a Hope and clear a Stress.
